claim: Patchline ships a learned abstraction-selection policy proven to never weaken soundness. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the never weaken soundness claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make abstraction-selection-policy-gate`.
